name: Crocodile
types: The Seven Warlords of the Sea
effect: [DON!! x1] When you activate an Event, you may draw 1 card if you have 4 or less cards in your hand and haven't drawn a card using this Leader's effect during this turn.

official_faq.question: I activated an Event when I had 6 cards in my hand, and then activated another Event when I had 5 cards in my hand. I now have 4 cards in my hand. At this time, can I draw a card according to this [DON!! x1] effect?
official_faq.answer: Yes. You can draw 1 card because you have not yet drawn a card with this effect during this turn.

official_faq.question: I activated "ST04-014 Lead Performer "Disaster"" when I had 5 cards in my hand, reducing my hand to 4 cards. That Event's effect then increased my hand to 5 cards. At this time, can I draw a card according to this [DON!! x1] effect?
official_faq.answer: No. You cannot draw a card because you have 5 or more cards in your hand after activating the Event.

official_faq.question: Can I draw a card according to this [DON!! x1] effect if I activate the [Trigger] effect of one of my Events?
official_faq.answer: No, you cannot. Activating a [Trigger] is not the same as activating an Event.

official_faq.question: At what time does the effect which states "when you activates an Event" activate?
official_faq.answer: After the Event has been activated and its effect has been resolved.
